morphology.pattern_note: 国家专名，标准书写须大写首字母；在现代马来语中整体记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。

senses.ms_definition: Nama sebuah negara di Asia Selatan.

etymology.historical_story: Pakistan began as a proposed political name before becoming a country name. Rahmat Ali promoted it in his 1933 pamphlet Now or Never, linking it to Punjab, Afghan Province, Kashmir, Sind and Baluchistan. Malay uses the resulting name as a whole proper noun, without Malay affixation. [Historical account](https://www.nihcr.edu.pk/Downloads/PDF%20Books/Foundations_of_Pakistan_Vol.II.pdf)
